data.narrative:
Sunfire is a Series E climate and energy company founded by Carl Berninghausen, Nils Aldag, and Christian von Olshausen that has raised $315M+ to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though direct peer valuation data at Sunfire's stage and tier proved insufficient for reliable median benchmarking.

Only one valuation method yielded applicable results. The Stage-Progression approach uses $315M in total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.4x multiplier typical of Series E advancement, implying a valuation of $441M. A peer-median method was not feasible: while 8 same-sector peers exist (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix), none met the screening thresholds of three or more comparable companies at identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given Sunfire's specialized technology positioning.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $375M (low) to $507M (high), with $441M as the median point. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty: reliance on stage-progression alone leaves the valuation sensitive to both the appropriateness of the 1.4x multiplier and the use of total raised as a valuation proxy. Resolution of valuation range tightening would benefit from either stronger peer comparables or disclosure of recent Series E terms.
